commands.name: search-all
commands.summary: Search companies and officers together by keyword. Results are mixed; the item class is type-company or type-officer.

commands.name: search-companies
commands.summary: Search companies by name or number. Returns name, profile URL, company number, incorporation or dissolution date and address.

commands.name: search-officers
commands.summary: Search company officers (directors, secretaries, corporate officers) by name. Returns links to each officer's appointments.

commands.name: search-disqualified-officers
commands.summary: Search disqualified directors by name. Returns links to each disqualification detail page.

commands.name: get-disqualified-officer
commands.summary: Get disqualification details for a person or company: date of birth, nationality, disqualification type, start and end dates, case reference, companies involved and reason.

commands.name: get-company
commands.summary: Get a company overview by company number: name, registered office address, status, SIC code and previous names.

commands.name: list-filing-history
commands.summary: List a company's filing history (date, type, description, PDF link), optionally filtered by category. Paginated.

commands.name: get-filing-document
commands.summary: Download a filing document PDF. The server redirects to a signed S3 URL.

commands.name: list-company-officers
commands.summary: List a company's officers (directors and secretaries) with role, appointment date, date of birth and links to their appointments.

commands.name: list-company-pscs
commands.summary: List a company's persons with significant control (owners and controllers), or the reason the company is exempt.

commands.name: list-company-charges
commands.summary: List a company's registered charges (mortgages and security agreements), with links to each charge's details.

commands.name: get-charge
commands.summary: Get one charge's details: type, created and delivered dates, status, filing transaction with PDF link, and persons entitled.

commands.name: get-officer-appointments
commands.summary: List all company appointments held by one officer: company, company status, role, appointed and resigned dates, correspondence address.

commands.name: advanced-search-companies
commands.summary: Advanced company search. Filter by name include/exclude, registered office address, incorporation and dissolution date ranges, status, SIC code and company type. Returns company names and profile URLs

commands.name: export-advanced-search-csv
commands.summary: Download advanced company search results as CSV, using the same filters as advanced-search-companies.

commands.name: search-dissolved-companies
commands.summary: Search companies dissolved since 1989 by their name at dissolution or by a previous name.

commands.name: alphabetical-search-companies
commands.summary: Browse the register alphabetically around a company name (40 rows per page). Returns name, number and status. Uses cursor paging via searchAfter/searchBefore.

commands.name: check-company-name-availability
commands.summary: Check whether a proposed company name is available by listing existing companies with the same or similar names.
